blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 MCA Launches 'Corporate Mitra' Scheme for MSME Compliance Training. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Offers 150 hours SWAYAM Plus online learning + 6 months on-job training for graduates up to 30 years old.
Eligibility & Course: Open to graduates up to 30 yrs old; 150 hrs SWAYAM Plus + 6 months on-job training.
Fee & Concession: Fee ₹3,000 + GST (50% concession for women and NE/Himalayan/Island candidates).
Institutional Partners: Rollout via IIT Madras, IIT Pravartak, ICAI, ICSI, and ICoAI.
Age limit (30 yrs) vs online course duration (150 hrs) vs fee (₹3,000 + GST).
